The Anambra State Governor’s wife, Dr Nonye Soludo, has celebrated five students who emerged champions at the 2026 Nigeria-Malaysia Bilateral Debate Tournament, describing it as “a massive victory, and another proud moment for Anambra State and Nigeria”. Soludo, in a press statement released on Saturday, said the students’ outstanding performance, intellectual depth and confidence at the international stage were a testament to the incredible potential of the young, amazing people of the state. The Anambra first lady, who is also the founder of the Non-Governmental Organisation, ‘Healthy Living with Nonye Soludo Initiative’, added that the students’ achievement speaks to the importance of the current administration’s intensive and intentional investments in the education sector. According to her, the administration has created opportunities, strengthening learning environments and nurturing talents that can compete and excel anywhere in the world. The statement read, “A massive victory, and another proud moment for Anambra State and Nigeria! 2027: Tompolo urges Anambra voters to back Tinubu Ogun ASUP seeks negotiation as strike enters third day Anambra unveils AI assistant to ease access to government services “I celebrate our five brilliant young students who have made history by emerging Champions at the 2026 Nigeria-Malaysia Bilateral Debate Tournament. “Their outstanding performance, intellectual depth and confidence on the international stage are a testament to the incredible potential of our young, amazing people. “This achievement also speaks to the importance of the ‘Solution’ administration’s intensive and intentional investments in Anambra’s education sector, particularly in creating opportunities, strengthening learning environments and nurturing talents that can compete and excel anywhere in the world. “To our young Champions, you have made Anambra proud. Keep dreaming, keep learning and keep breaking boundaries. Your future is bright, and we are cheering you on!” Ikenna Obianeri Ikenna Obianeri is a journalist at Punch Newspapers with over 10 years of experience in reporting and storytelling.
